answer: Trust spreads like a vine from verified seeds: random walks wander the graph of real collaborations, and because the honest region mixes fast while Sybil accounts cluster behind a few narrow attack edges, walks almost never cross into them. An ocean of invented identities stays dry, starved of rank. Each fake identity needs its own genuine trust edge from an honest member, and such edges grow only from sustained interaction that cannot be copied or parallelized. Like a lotus rooted in one place, standing is anchored to verifiable history.
